# Sumukh Singh Portfolio — llms-full.txt
# Full extended version of llms.txt with complete case study descriptions.

> Sumukh Singh is a creative strategist and content marketer based in Delhi, India. He builds campaigns, content systems, and short-form creative for startups, founders, and growing teams.

## About

Sumukh Singh works where data, creative, and attention meet. He moves between strategy, content, analytics and execution, staying close enough to the work to make the thing himself.

"Creative with a spreadsheet. The spreadsheet tells me what's happening. The creative gives people a reason to care."

Contact: sumukh.workk@gmail.com  
GitHub: https://github.com/X-SUMUKH-X  
Location: Delhi, India

## Capabilities

### Campaign Systems (strategy → output)
End-to-end campaign thinking: positioning, messaging, content architecture, creative direction and execution.
Tags: positioning, messaging, content systems, creative direction.
Process: brief → idea → launch.

### Short-Form Content (hook → payoff)
Hooks, scripts, formats and content systems built for the speed of the feed.
Tags: hooks, scripts, formats, content systems.

## Selected Work (Case Studies)

### 1. Fokus App — Short-Form Content System
Category: short-form content
Result: 2.1M views in 24 hours.
Task: Build short-form content system from scratch. Hook-first scripts, format selection and distribution strategy for a productivity app targeting Gen Z.
Role: content strategy, scripting, hook writing, format design.
Move: Led with identity crisis, not features. Designed the hook around a shared pain point rather than the product.

### 2. Swiggy Instamart Campaign
Category: campaign systems
Result: Viral reach, significant organic engagement.
Task: Create a campaign that made Swiggy Instamart feel culturally relevant beyond grocery delivery.
Role: campaign concepting, messaging, creative direction, execution.

### 3. Slack × Swiggy HQ
Category: brand partnership creative
Task: Position Slack as the operational backbone of Swiggy's fast-paced internal culture.
Role: creative direction, copy, brand partnership framing.

### 4. Josh Talks AI — Editorial UX Redesign
Category: website redesign / editorial UX
Task: Redesign the Josh Talks AI landing page to feel authoritative and editorially credible.
Role: UX design, editorial strategy, web development.

### 5. Launchverse — Multi-Brand Product Launch
Category: product launch strategy
Task: Coordinate and execute a multi-brand product launch across social, content and distribution channels.
Role: launch strategy, content systems, execution.

### 6. Blinkit Metrics — Power BI Dashboard
Category: data analytics / Power BI
Result: ₹1.2M in sales data analyzed.
Task: Turn raw Blinkit sales data into a dashboard that makes patterns easier to see and discuss.
Role: data analysis, dashboard design, insight framing.
Move: Structured the dashboard around decision-relevant metrics instead of exposing the dataset as a wall of numbers.
